chunks: (Fighting during) the holy month (if the sanctity) of the holy month (is violated) is (just) retribution. So if you are oppressed, oppress those who oppress you to the same degree, and fear God, and know that God is with those who are pious and follow the right path.

key_terms.الْمُتَّقِينَ: The pious / Those who fear God

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on retaliating for violating the sanctity of the holy month in Islam?
ai.summary: This verse, known as the Verse of the Holy Months, establishes the principle of equal retribution (qisas) for violating the sanctity of the holy month, extending the general rule of retaliation to include sacred prohibitions. It instructs believers to respond to aggression with proportionate force while maintaining God-consciousness, affirming that God supports the pious. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the Battle of Dhat al-Riqa, highlighting the continuity of the four sacred months and the divine validation of proportional justice in warfare.
